note: Open: the bands call new_domain_volume wrong, because the domain was registered more than 180 days ago. The call is that it is acceptable: the week before it sent 400 messages, and the earlier open rate of 64% is what a small stream of mail that people are waiting for looks like, so the domain has an age but no history of bulk sending. 75,000 messages from it in one week, opened at 17%, is a warm-up risk in everything but name. The spike and the fall in opens already carry the main point and follow the bands, so the type is not expected, but a specialist who says the domain is new to receivers at this volume is right. It rests on the warm-up advice in M3AAWG's sender best practices, which is about sending history, not registration date.
